description: Generate a 送り状 CSV for all un-shipped orders, formatted for import into ヤマト B2クラウド (courier=yamato) or 佐川 e飛伝 (courier=sagawa). No carrier API/contract needed — import the CSV to request pickup. Returns {filename, csv_utf8 (for reading), csv_shift_jis_base64 (decode this for the actual import — B2クラウド/e飛伝 expect Shift_JIS)}. First time, register the column layout in B2クラウド. Owner-only.
